name: AI output verifier
oneLiner: The quiet rate-limiter on every agent deployment: a person who can tell when the machine is wrong, at volume, in their own domain.
why: Reviewing outputs, handling exceptions and assuring quality is the work AI creates alongside the work it does
Even in the most AI-applicable occupations, the human share concentrates in checking, judging and communicating
threats: Verifier models — AI checking AI — could take the volume and leave only the exceptions
The work may remain a task inside every job rather than becoming a job of its own

claims.text: McKinsey's agents work treats human oversight — reviewing outputs, handling exceptions, assuring quality, documenting decisions — as the standing obligation that comes with deployment.
Microsoft's study of 200,000 anonymised Copilot conversations found the highest-applicability occupations keep humans on the tasks AI helps with least: verification, judgement and communication.
